name: HERO MOTORS LIMITED
summary: Hero Motors Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and supplies engineered powertrain solutions catering to automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in United States, Europe, India, and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations region. It operates through Powertrain Solutions and Alloys and Metallics segments. The company offers gears and transmission products comprising ice and EV gearboxes, e-axles, gearset assemblies, and gear and shaft components; bike powertrains products, such as continuous variable transmission products, electric motors, and electric drive units; and alloys and metallic products, including structural components, alloy frames, suspension forks, wheel rims,…
